title: Stalks commute with the explicit symmetric algebra sheaf
statement: For a scheme X, an O_X-module sheaf F, and x ∈ X, the stalk at x of the fixed SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.algebra F [lem-weil-pbc-symmetric-algebra-sheaf-construction] is ring-isomorphic to Sym_{O_{X,x}}(F_x). The comparison takes scalar germs to the algebra map and generator germs to SymmetricAlgebra.ι. No quasi-coherence assumption is needed.

proof.text: The maps from the sectionwise symmetric algebras to Sym(F_x) induced by germ scalars and module germs form a cocone, hence a ring map from the presheaf stalk. Construct the inverse from the scalar stalk map and the linear generator map using SymmetricAlgebra.lift.

proof.text: Every stalk element has a representative, and finite sets have a common neighbourhood. Symmetric-algebra induction on scalars and generators proves the two composites are identities. The stalk of ring sheafification is canonically the presheaf stalk, with its germ formula, so transport this equivalence to the fixed algebra sheaf.

lean.statement:
theorem stalk_iso :
    ∃ e : TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := CommRingCat) (algebra F).right.obj x ≅
        CommRingCat.of (SymmetricAlgebra (X.presheaf.stalk x)
          ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).obj F)),
      (∀ (U : X.Opens) (hx : x ∈ U) (r : Γ(X, U)),
        e.hom (TopCat.Presheaf.germ (algebra F).right.obj U x hx
          ((algebra F).hom.hom.app (op U) r)) =
            algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x)
              (SymmetricAlgebra (X.presheaf.stalk x)
                ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).obj F))
                  (X.presheaf.germ U x hx r)) ∧
      ∀ (U : X.Opens) (hx : x ∈ U) (m : F.val.obj (op U)),
        e.hom (TopCat.Presheaf.germ (algebra F).right.obj U x hx
          ((inclusion F).val.app (op U) m)) =
            SymmetricAlgebra.ι (X.presheaf.stalk x)
              ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).obj F)
                (TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf U x hx m)
